description: This file contains the abstract base class 'Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase' which provides core methods and properties for compiling Smarty templates, including managing plugins, handling template sections, error reporting, and code filtering. It serves as a foundation for template compilation in Smarty.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_TemplateCompilerBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing core compilation features for Smarty templates, including plugin management, code filtering, error handling, and template processing.

methods.name: compileTemplate
methods.description: Compiles a complete Smarty template into executable code.

methods.name: compileTemplateSource
methods.description: Processes the source code of a Smarty template, applying filters and handling dependencies to produce compiled code.

methods.name: postFilter
methods.description: Applies post-processing filters to compiled code.

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: Applies pre-processing filters to template source before compilation.

methods.name: compileTag
methods.description: Compiles a specific template tag using lazy-loaded tag compiler classes.

methods.name: compileVariable
methods.description: Generates PHP code for a template variable.

methods.name: compileConfigVariable
methods.description: Generates PHP code to access a configuration variable.

methods.name: compilePHPFunctionCall
methods.description: Generates PHP code for a PHP function call within a template.

methods.name: syntaxMatchesVariable
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid PHP variable name.

methods.name: processText
methods.description: Processes template text, removing unnecessary whitespace and handling special tags.

methods.name: callTagCompiler
methods.description: Dynamically loads and calls the compiler class for a given tag.

methods.name: getTagCompiler
methods.description: Lazy loads and retrieves the compiler class for a specific template tag.

methods.name: getPlugin
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate plugin function for a given plugin name and type, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: getPluginFromDefaultHandler
methods.description: Uses the default plugin handler to locate and load a plugin if not found in standard locations.

methods.name: appendCode
methods.description: Concatenates PHP code segments, optimizing PHP closing/opening tags.

methods.name: processNocacheCode
methods.description: Injects code to handle nocache sections within templates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Extracts an ID from a string if it matches a specific pattern.

methods.name: getVariableName
methods.description: Extracts a variable name from a string if it matches the expected pattern.

methods.name: setNocacheInVariable
methods.description: Marks a template variable as nocache.

methods.name: convertScope
methods.description: Converts a scope attribute value to an internal scope representation.

methods.name: makeNocacheCode
methods.description: Generates PHP code for a nocache section.

methods.name: trigger_template_error
methods.description: Handles and reports template or parsing errors with detailed information.

methods.name: getVarExport
methods.description: Returns a var_export() string with whitespace removed.

methods.name: enterDoubleQuote
methods.description: Handles state preservation when entering a double-quoted string.

methods.name: getTagStackCount
methods.description: Returns the current count of nested tags.

methods.name: replaceDelimiter
methods.description: Replaces delimiter placeholders in regex patterns.

methods.name: initDelimiterPreg
methods.description: Builds regex patterns for template delimiters and literals.

methods.name: leaveDoubleQuote
methods.description: Ensures all double-quoted string blocks are properly closed.

methods.name: getLdelPreg
methods.description: Returns the regex pattern for the left delimiter.

methods.name: getRdelPreg
methods.description: Returns the regex pattern for the right delimiter.

methods.name: getLdelLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the left delimiter.

methods.name: getRdelLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the right delimiter.

methods.name: getOpenBlockTag
methods.description: Returns the name of the current open block tag, or false if none.

methods.name: isVariable
methods.description: Determines whether a value contains variable elements.

methods.name: getNewPrefixVariable
methods.description: Generates a new prefix variable name for template code.

methods.name: getPrefixVariable
methods.description: Returns the current prefix variable name.

methods.name: appendPrefixCode
methods.description: Adds code to the prefix buffer.

methods.name: getPrefixCode
methods.description: Retrieves the concatenated prefix code.

methods.name: saveRequiredPlugins
methods.description: Saves current plugin requirements, optionally resetting for new compilation.

methods.name: restoreRequiredPlugins
methods.description: Restores previously saved plugin requirements.

methods.name: compileRequiredPlugins
methods.description: Generates PHP code to ensure required plugins are available.

methods.name: compileCheckPlugins
methods.description: Generates code to check if plugins are loaded and callable.

methods.name: doCompile
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for actual source compilation.

methods.name: cStyleComment
methods.description: Converts a string into a C-style comment .

methods.name: compileTag2
methods.description: Performs detailed processing and compilation of a specific template tag, including plugin and object method resolution.
